old_findings.note: The StableMath products are still distributed and the Newton steps unnamed. computeInvariant (0x72c98186) changed only in hex display, and computeBalance's loop keeps its 250+-character quotients.

regressions.lines: e.g. getStablePoolDynamicData's allocation checks and its return (last 12 lines)
regressions.old: if _25 + ceil32(_3) + ceil32(return_data.size) + 576 < _25 + ceil32(_3) + ceil32(return_data.size) + 256 or ...
regressions.issue: Allocation bases the old text named (_7, _25) are now printed as absolute sums of every earlier allocation and return-data size, the same change as in c00150. Lines with 4+ pointer terms went 40 -> 124, with 8+ terms 26 -> 63, and lines over 240 characters 56 -> 74.
regressions.rule: Bind a free-memory-pointer value that is a sum of several symbolic sizes to a variable at the allocation and address its contents from it. Substitute only constants or single terms.

improvements: Returns decode as Array(...) and struct fields (getTokens, b156aa0a, getStablePoolDynamicData: 3 -> 11 Array forms). The Vault event call c8088247 is decoded in start/stopAmplificationParameterUpdate ('AmpUpdateStarted', Array(len=128, data=uint64(...), ...)), and totalSupply(this) and 4f037ee7(this) in getStablePoolDynamicData. permit's ecrecover takes (digest, v, r, s), and its dropped mem[64] bump is compensated (mem[64] - 32 -> mem[64]). Dead memory writes are dropped. P2 4 -> 0, P6 13 -> 0, 40 -> 34 whiles (return copies).
notes: I read the 12 changed defs' diffs. supportsInterface, eip712Domain (84b0196e) and computeInvariant changed only by the whole-byte hex display. computeBalance (16a0b3e0) has a new explicit Panic(17) check, the overflow of 2w + b, where the old text had SafeMath.add(SafeMath.mul3(2, w), b) inside the next comparison. Both revert Panic(17), and the SafeMath.div inside only recomputes b, which was computed and checked before the loop: neutral. All six source loops are still whiles. text_check run --per-selector 16, both worlds: 611 + 48 guessed-param calls same, 0 different.
summary: One medium regression: free-pointer memory addressed by long absolute sums (124 lines with 4+ terms, 40 before). Otherwise improved: returns and the Vault event calls decoded, ecrecover decoded, P2 and P6 gone. The StableMath readability finding stays.
